title: The cutting wheel
notes: World 2 is the cutting wheel: your tower stands on a cradle on the axle of a spiked wheel. Drop over the axle to steady it; drop on a treadle pad to kick the wheel and cut down through the earth, balancing the lean.
The Dark follows from above; its arm takes anything dropped on its side for a while.
Grey-box art on purpose until the loop is right in your hands.
